messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled migration job `mig/2026-03-shard-priority` starting in the 02:00 UTC change window. Steps: lock -> schema apply -> staggered reindex -> backfill gating. See runbook: https://runbooks.internal/mig-2026-03 :package:
Maria H: I'm on-call for this window, can take lead for lock handoff.
Aj Patel: I'll pair with Maria for monitoring and quick rollbacks.
Leo W: Heads-up: the reindex touches 3 large tenant shards, prefer >3m gap between shard reindexes to avoid IO thundering.
Sasha G: Agree with gaps. Also request pinning the app rollout to v3.8.1 for 30m after schema apply to catch regressions.
db-ops: Noted. Constraint checks could add ~10-15m per shard if we run ANALYZE+VALIDATE. Recommend run `pg_validate --table tenant_metrics --mode fast` in canary first.
Maria H: Plan: 02:00 acquire table lock (exclusive short lock), 02:02 apply DDL, 02:05 start shard-0 reindex, wait 5m, shard-1, wait, shard-2. Backfill job staged but gated by success flags.
Aj Patel: If any shard reindex exceeds expected IO threshold, we abort reindex and drop to fallback plan (skip reindex, leave index creation deferred). Which signal do we use for escape hatch? :question:
Sasha G: Use `:rotating_light: abort-reindex` in this thread + deploy-bot pinned comment. Ops will trigger rollback to previous schema-only migration.
deploy-bot: Can only hold a lock for 10m by default. You requested extended lock. Approve? Type `approve-extended-lock` to extend to 40m.
Maria H: approve-extended-lock
deploy-bot: Lock extension granted to 40m. :white_check_mark:
Leo W: Quick checklist before DDL: snapshot replication lag < 300ms, disk_iops < 70% baseline, replica catchup cleared. I'll monitor.
db-ops: FYI: we added a guard in migration to abort if replica lag > 5s.
Aj Patel: Rollback plan note: rollback path is to run `mig/2026-03-revert` which will remove new index artifacts and restore pinned config for app. Confirm owners for executing revert?
Sasha G: Ops + Maria execute revert; Aj coordinates app pin.
Maria H: I'll post updates in the channel when lock acquired and after each shard completes.
deploy-bot: Deploy note: release notes auto-generated at /releases/mig-2026-03. Include migration id and rollback commands.
Leo W: One more: throttle backfill concurrency to 4 workers. We're scheduling backfill to start 30m after final shard if everything is green.
Aj Patel: Logging snippet for postmortem if needed:
```
PG_STAT_ACTIVITY: peak_waiters=4, avg_io=125MB/s, replica_lag=0.12s
reindex_duration_shard0=298s
```
Maria H: On it, starting to acquire lock at 02:00.
Sasha G: :thumbsup: good luck, keep the thread updated.
deploy-bot: Migration started: lock acquired by Maria H. Good luck team. :rocket:
